title: FileSecure configuration
description: Configuration of FileSecure 13: pipelines of stages moving, copying and converting files. See the README for details.

pipelines.description: The pipelines, run one after another.

templates.description: Ignored by FileSecure, free content. The place to define YAML anchors (&name) reused elsewhere with aliases (*name) or merge keys (<<: *name).

pipeline.description: A sequence of stages applied to every file found in the inputs of its mappings.

useDefaults.description: Merge the top-level defaults into this pipeline.

mappings.description: Mandatory unless mappingTable is set. Folders to process: a file at input/a/b.txt has output/a/b.txt as initial destination.

stages.description: The stages, applied in the given order. Stages from defaults are placed before them.

setFileCreationDate.description: Set the creation and modification dates of the destination to the date found in the file name or in its metadata.

temp.description: Folder where conversions write before their result is moved to its destination. Default: the system temporary folder.

folderActions.description: Actions applied to every visited input folder once all files are processed, deepest folders first. Actions from defaults are placed before them.

defaults.description: Settings merged into every pipeline not having useDefaults: false. Their stages and folderActions are placed before the pipeline's own, scan is merged key by key (the pipeline's keys win), other keys apply when the pipeline doesn't set them.

mapping.description: An input folder and the output folder its files are sent to.

output.description: Folder the files are sent to, keeping their path relative to input.

mappingTable.description: Many mappings sharing base folders: each entry key: value becomes the mapping {input: <input>/<key>, output: <output>/<value>}, added after the pipeline's own mappings.

input.description: Base folder of the entry keys.

output.description: Base folder of the entry values.

paths.description: Rewrites applied separately to every key and every value: the first rule whose regex fully matches it is applied. Paths matching no rule are kept.

entries.description: Map of relative input path to relative output path. Paths can't be empty, absolute or contain '..'. Values read as numbers or booleans must be quoted.

regexRule.description: Rewrites a path fully matching regex with replacement.

regex.description: Java regex that must match the whole path, '/' being the separator. Best written between single quotes.

replacement.description: Replacement where $1 or ${name} refer to the groups of the regex.

scan.description: How the input folders are visited.

maxDepth.description: How many levels of sub-folders are visited, 1 only processes the files directly in input. Default: no limit.

excludedFolders.description: Java regexes matched against the folder path relative to input, using '/' as separator (e.g. 'a/b'). Matching folders are not visited.

operation.description: What is done with accepted files: COPY, MOVE, MOVE_WITH_COPY (copy then delete, for moves across file systems) or NONE (only logs what would be done). Case-insensitive for FileSecure.

conflict.description: When the destination already exists: RENAME uses the first free name among 'name (1).ext', 'name (2).ext'...; SKIP leaves the file untouched. Case-insensitive for FileSecure.

verify.description: How files copied to their destination (COPY, MOVE_WITH_COPY, MOVE across file systems, converted files) are checked before being renamed to their final name: SIZE compares the sizes; CHECKSUM also compares the SHA-256 of the source, computed while copying, with the one of the copy read back (slower: the copy is forced to storage then read again). Atomic renames on the same file system aren't checked, nothing being copied. Case-insensitive for FileSecure.

processor.description: VIDEO_TO_HEVC_MKV, VIDEO_TO_HEVC_MP4: H264, VP9, WMV3, MPEG2 videos into HEVC + AAC. VIDEO_TO_AV1_MKV: into AV1 + OPUS. MP3_TO_AAC: MP3 into AAC (.m4a). AUDIO_TO_OPUS: MP3, AAC into OPUS. TIFF_TO_JPG: TIFF into JPEG. PHOTO_TO_AVIF, PHOTO_TO_JXL: heic, tiff, jpg, raf into AVIF, JXL. Case-insensitive for FileSecure.

pattern.description: Java regex. Best written between single quotes.

zone.description: Time zone ID (e.g. Europe/Paris) of the date. Default: the system time zone.

locale.description: Language of the date format (month and day names).

stage.description: A stage, chosen by its type.

NameFilter.description: Keeps files whose name fully matches one of the includes (all files if empty) and none of the excludes.

includes.description: Java regexes, the file name must fully match one of them. All files are included when empty.

excludes.description: Java regexes, files whose name fully matches one of them are skipped.

IfOlderThan.description: Keeps files whose date (from their name, metadata or last modification) is older than the offset.

FolderCanonical.description: Prefixes the destination with one folder per character of its first path element: 'going/file' with 3 becomes 'g/o/i/going/file'.

elementCount.description: How many characters, and so folders, are used.

FolderPerDay.description: Prefixes the destination with yyyy/MM/dd/ from the file date.

FolderPerWeek.description: Prefixes the destination with yyyy/MM/w/ from the file date, w being the week of the month.

FolderPerMonth.description: Prefixes the destination with yyyy/MM/ from the file date.

FolderPerYear.description: Prefixes the destination with yyyy/ from the file date.

FolderUniquePerDay.description: Prefixes the destination with yyyy-MM-dd/ from the file date.

Lowercase.description: Lowercases the destination folders (not the file name).

RenameWithDate.description: Renames the file with its date (from its name, metadata or last modification), keeping its extension.

format.description: Java DateTimeFormatter pattern of the new name.

filters.description: When set, only files whose original name fully matches one of these Java regexes are renamed.

RenameWithDatePattern.description: Renames the file with a date read from its current name, keeping its extension. Files not matching regex are skipped.

regex.description: Java regex fully matching the name, defining the named groups date and time.

dateFormat.description: Java DateTimeFormatter pattern of the date group.

timeFormat.description: Java DateTimeFormatter pattern of the time group.

outputFormat.description: Java DateTimeFormatter pattern of the new name.

RegexPath.description: Rewrites the destination relative to the output folder (with '/' separators) with the first rule whose regex fully matches it.

unmatched.description: What happens to files matching no rule: SKIP leaves them untouched, PASS keeps them unchanged in the pipeline. Case-insensitive for FileSecure.

Convert.description: Plans the conversion of media files with the first processor able to handle them, the destination extension changes accordingly. Only one per pipeline.

processors.description: Processors tried in order. Default: VIDEO_TO_HEVC_MKV, MP3_TO_AAC, TIFF_TO_JPG.

extensions.description: Only files with these extensions are probed. Default: mp4, mov, mkv, avi, tiff, mp3, m4a, m4v, ts, m2ts, mts, heic, jpg, raf.

unhandled.description: What happens to files that won't be converted: SKIP leaves them untouched, PASS lets them continue through the pipeline unchanged. Case-insensitive for FileSecure.

cache.description: H2 database file remembering files that can't be converted, so they aren't probed again on the next runs.

probeFilter.description: A filter on the media probed by ffprobe, chosen by its type. Files that couldn't be probed never pass.

LengthMoreThan.description: Keeps media lasting at least value seconds.

LengthLessThan.description: Keeps media lasting at most value seconds.

folderAction.description: An action applied to every visited input folder, chosen by its type.

DeleteIfEmpty.description: Deletes empty folders at least depth levels below the input folder.

DeleteIfOlderThan.description: Deletes empty folders at least depth levels below the input folder, last modified before the offset.

DeleteChildren.description: Deletes the given files in every folder.

names.description: Names of the files to delete, e.g. [Thumbs.db, desktop.ini].

depth.description: Minimum depth of the deleted folders below the input folder, the input itself being at depth 0.
